question: At a finite EFT onset, can the usual instantaneous adiabatic relative-density and common-velocity conditions determine the preferred-foliation shear B0, or are they exactly invariant under the certified Newtonian/preferred source time-shift and therefore unable to supply the missing O(k^2) comoving coefficient/UV boundary data by themselves?

scope.onset: finite a_EFT>0 inside the declared EFT domain
scope.background: rho_i_prime=-3H(rho_i+p_i) for separately conserved baseline species at the onset

acceptance: prove delta_rho_pref,i/rho_i_prime=delta_rho_N,i/rho_i_prime-B, so every relative entropy difference delta_rho_i/rho_i_prime-delta_rho_j/rho_j_prime is exactly invariant
for barotropic notation prove delta_i,pref/(1+w_i)=delta_i,N/(1+w_i)+3H B, so equality of delta_i/(1+w_i) across species is unchanged for arbitrary finite B
prove v_i:=q_i/[a(rho_i+p_i)] transforms as v_pref,i=v_N,i-B, so relative velocities v_i-v_j and a common-velocity adiabatic condition are exactly invariant
combine with C10.53: leading finite-B constraints reduce to total comoving regularity and do not contain B0 independently
combine with C10.54: B0 is fixed only after the gauge-invariant O(k^2) total comoving coefficient C2 is specified

conclude that instantaneous finite-onset adiabaticity plus leading k-regularity cannot manufacture C2 or B0; a temporal growing-mode/attractor condition or matching to a pre-EFT/UV initial state is required
do not call this a new propagating scalar or an isocurvature detection; it is a boundary-data statement for the finite-onset low-energy DAE
next_if_pass: Freeze two non-equivalent physical initialization routes: (A) a UV/pre-EFT matching datum for the gauge-invariant C2 (or equivalent curvature-gradient datum), and (B) an in-EFT attractor/growing-mode test showing whether C2/B0 loses sensitivity to admissible onset data. Test route B before introducing arbitrary UV parameters.
non_claims: does not prove B0 is a new degree of freedom
does not prove a physical isocurvature mode exists
does not select a UV completion or boundary value
does not calculate C2 or B0
does not implement completed-U1 CLASS feedback
does not change historical likelihood results
